## Checklist
- [ ] `make test` passes (Python tests, web tests, typecheck)
- [ ] If the risk index changed in one language, it is changed in the other and the parity fixture was regenerated
- [ ] Any new layer, number or claim shows its **source** and its **status** (observed / derived / proxy / simulated)
- [ ] No claim of accuracy, probability or "safe route" that has not been validated
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour or structure changed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
